correctness.rationale: Independently generated GP(8,3) with 16 vertices/24 edges and tested all 65,536 induced vertex subsets with union-find: 50,996 nonempty forest faces; face vector (16,120,560,1820,4368,7984,11200,11792,8672,3792,672). Deterministic vertex-order matching gives 25,475 pairs and critical dimensions 0:1,8:8,9:33,10:4. Independently checked all 375,040 Hasse covers acyclic, formed exact integer Morse matrices d9 (8 by 33, rank 8) and d10 (33 by 4, zero). Columns (21,3,2,1,5,10,12,18) of d9 have determinant -1, proving primitiveness. After degree-unit cancellations, 25 nine-spheres remain and every ten-cell has zero degree attaching map into their 9-skeleton, yielding precisely wedge^25 S9 plus wedge^4 S10.
residual_risks: Self-contained exact finite reconstruction does not itself certify the historic original tree identity; locked Git blobs and source tree SHA guard supplied.
